website_summary.name: CoachMate
website_summary.description: CoachMate is a sleek, beige-themed web application designed for matching coaches and users through personalized assessments and interactive features.
website_summary.appearance: The website features a clean and organized layout with a beige background and saddle brown accents applied to various components, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. The personality assessment page includes a series of dropdown menus for selecting preferences related to personality traits. Each question is clearly presented with corresponding options, ensuring ease of use. The "Submit Assessment" button stands out with its distinct styling, encouraging user interaction. The overall design emphasizes simplicity and user-friendliness, focusing on guiding users through the assessment process seamlessly.
website_summary.functionality: The website offers several key functionalities aimed at enhancing the coaching experience. Users can complete a personality assessment by answering questions about their preferences and tendencies. This assessment helps in matching them with suitable coaches who align with their personality traits. Additionally, users can create and manage their profiles, providing personal details and preferences. They can also search for and select appropriate coaches based on compatibility scores derived from the assessment. Scheduling coaching sessions and setting goals are facilitated through intuitive interfaces. Progress tracking tools allow users to monitor their development over time, ensuring continuous improvement and motivation.

functionality_testing.name: Dropdown Menu Test
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that clicking the dropdown menus displays the correct options.
functionality_testing.coverage_element: Outer world/Inner world, Concrete, factual information/Abstract, theoretical ideas, Logic and objective analysis/Values and personal feelings, Structured, planned way/Flexible, spontaneous way
functionality_testing.preconditions: The dropdown menus are in their default state.
functionality_testing.expected_results: The dropdown menus should display the correct options when clicked.
procedure: Click on the Outer world/Inner world dropdown menu.
Verify that the correct options are displayed.
Repeat steps 1-2 for the other dropdown menus.

functionality_testing.name: Dropdown Selection Test
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that selecting options from the dropdown menus works correctly.
functionality_testing.coverage_element: Dropdown for Question 1,Dropdown for Question 2,Dropdown for Question 3,Dropdown for Question 4
functionality_testing.preconditions: The personality assessment page is loaded.
functionality_testing.expected_results: The selected options should be displayed correctly in each dropdown menu.
procedure: Select an option from each dropdown menu.
Verify that the selected options are displayed correctly.

functionality_testing.name: Page Refresh or Loading Test
functionality_testing.objective: To validate whether the webpage correctly loads interactive elements upon being refreshed.
functionality_testing.preconditions: At least one previous navigational action should ensure that the page can potentially host interactive elements.
functionality_testing.expected_results: The webpage should load properly, revealing all interactive elements required to complete the profile creation.
procedure: Confirm that the expected elements for user interaction are visibly loaded and functional.

functionality_testing.name: Submit Assessment Test
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that clicking the Submit Assessment button submits the assessment.
functionality_testing.preconditions: Options have been selected in each dropdown menu.
functionality_testing.expected_results: A confirmation message should appear indicating successful submission. 7. Next Steps : Select options for each question using the dropdown menus.
procedure: Verify that a confirmation message appears indicating successful submission.

design_validation_testing.name: UI Design and Style Test: Color Palette
design_validation_testing.objective: To verify that the background color is consistently beige and the buttons and dropdowns are styled with saddle brown.
design_validation_testing.expected_results: The background should consistently appear beige, and the buttons and dropdowns should be styled with saddle brown.
procedure: Observe the background color and the color of the buttons and dropdowns.
Evaluate the color consistency and style uniformity.
Compare against the specified design requirements.
